name: linklater
description: Linklater is an Instapaper-inspired “read it later” app.
author: Nick Schneble

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @linklater/api && npm run build --workspace @linklater/web
scripts.dev:test: TESTING_UI=1 DATABASE_URL=$(node -e "const u=new URL(require('fs').readFileSync('apps/api/.env','utf8').match(/^DATABASE_URL\s*=\s*\"?([^\"\n]+)\"?/m)[1]); u.pathname='/linklater_testing_ui'; process.stdout.write(u.toString())") concurrently "npm run dev --workspace @linklater/api" "npm run dev --workspace @linklater/web"
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace @linklater/api && npm run format --workspace @linklater/web && npm run format --workspace @linklater/testing-ui
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @linklater/api && npm run lint --workspace @linklater/web && npm run lint --workspace @linklater/testing-ui
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov --workspace @linklater/api && npm run test:cov --workspace @linklater/web
